last_funding.notes: A US$30 million follow-on investment from Insight Partners is reported, but the actual round month could not be established reliably. Startup Daily's October 8, 2025 report explicitly says it was secured in 2024, whereas funding aggregators date it October 8, 2025 and disagree on stage. The empty stage/date are required-schema placeholders, not asserted facts.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 13, 2026, launched a built-in remote MCP server for Octopus Cloud, enabling AI clients to inspect deployments, create and promote releases, execute runbooks, and investigate failures. This falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official job board has no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive openings. Older third-party account-executive listings do not establish current hiring.

model_provider.notes: The Generative AI section explicitly identifies pre-trained foundational models from OpenAI and Anthropic, hosted in private, secure cloud instances.

named_customers.notes: Both are documented customer case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current board lists two Revenue Systems Specialist openings and three regional expressions-of-interest listings; no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science titles.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022; also states GDPR compliance. GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not an independently issued certification. No HIPAA or PCI DSS claim found on the reviewed trust page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Revenue Systems Specialist posting identifies HubSpot as the central revenue platform, a Salesforce-to-HubSpot migration, and HubSpot–Zuora integrations. Zuora is the connected billing system.

product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy provides continuous delivery, deployment automation, GitOps, and release orchestration for software and platform engineering teams deploying across cloud, Kubernetes, and on-premises environments.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leadership page lacks joining dates and does not cover all VP-level staff. Michael Nguyen's profile dates his Chief Customer Officer role to September 2026, but he already worked at Octopus Deploy; this verifies an internal promotion, not a company join or departure. No qualifying external join/departure could be verified. Boolean is a required-schema placeholder, not an asserted negative.

eng_blog.notes: Pawel Pabich, Principal Software Engineer, explains Octopus Cloud's cell-based architecture; Andrew Best explains the engineering process and implementation decisions behind Octopus Server's target architecture.

claygent-auto-A.reasoning: Most fields are supported by current first-party product, trust, documentation, case-study, and recruitment pages, supplemented by LinkedIn for headcount and headquarters. Hiring negatives use the current official job board rather than stale mirrored advertisements. The October 2026 MCP announcement establishes a qualifying launch. Funding sources conflict on transaction timing: the detailed news report distinguishes actual 2024 financing from October 2025 reporting, so the exact latest-round tuple remains unknown. Leadership promotions were not silently treated as external executive arrivals. Unknown fields retain placeholders only because the supplied tool schema requires value fields.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters address is in South Brisbane, Queensland.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes numerous setup, migration, networking, permissions, maintenance, and disaster-recovery articles.

raised_18mo.notes: Window: May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. Although published October 8, 2025, the report explicitly says the latest US$30 million funding was secured in 2024 before the Codefresh acquisition. Publication date is not treated as the financing date.

founded_year.notes: Company history identifies Paul and Sonia Stovell as founders in 2012.

last_funding.notes: A US$30 million follow-on investment from Insight Partners is reported, but the actual round month could not be established reliably. Startup Daily's October 8, 2025 report explicitly says it was secured in 2024, whereas funding aggregators date it October 8, 2025 and disagree on stage. The empty stage/date are required-schema placeholders, not asserted facts.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 13, 2026, launched a built-in remote MCP server for Octopus Cloud, enabling AI clients to inspect deployments, create and promote releases, execute runbooks, and investigate failures. This falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official job board has no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive openings. Older third-party account-executive listings do not establish current hiring.

model_provider.notes: The Generative AI section explicitly identifies pre-trained foundational models from OpenAI and Anthropic, hosted in private, secure cloud instances.

named_customers.notes: Both are documented customer case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current board lists two Revenue Systems Specialist openings and three regional expressions-of-interest listings; no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science titles.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022; also states GDPR compliance. GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not an independently issued certification. No HIPAA or PCI DSS claim found on the reviewed trust page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Revenue Systems Specialist posting identifies HubSpot as the central revenue platform, a Salesforce-to-HubSpot migration, and HubSpot–Zuora integrations. Zuora is the connected billing system.

product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy provides continuous delivery, deployment automation, GitOps, and release orchestration for software and platform engineering teams deploying across cloud, Kubernetes, and on-premises environments.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leadership page lacks joining dates and does not cover all VP-level staff. Michael Nguyen's profile dates his Chief Customer Officer role to September 2026, but he already worked at Octopus Deploy; this verifies an internal promotion, not a company join or departure. No qualifying external join/departure could be verified. Boolean is a required-schema placeholder, not an asserted negative.
